issue_request: FHIR-32003 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked PA to correct RelatedPerson.communication and RelatedPerson.communication.preferred definitions so they refer to communication with the related person, not the patient.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 8b3b4cd9ad8075759a0654ecd203848080d6a463, which corrected RelatedPerson.communication short/definition, RelatedPerson.communication.language short, and RelatedPerson.communication.preferred definition in source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes RelatedPerson and assigns it to PA. Current XML source and the RelatedPerson-to-ParticipantLiving mapping exception contain the corrected wording. Later applied issue FHIR-41524 intentionally changed communication.language definitions across PA communication-language elements, including RelatedPerson.communication.language, to the current generic individual-language definition. The checked-in RelatedPerson SVG still has stale tooltip titles, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact and not the authoritative definition source.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build-scope XML source already satisfies FHIR-32003, and the only mismatch found is an SVG-only stale tooltip artifact that should not be edited as the sole source change under this workflow.
